title: Gobi Paratha
description: Punjabi whole wheat flatbread stuffed with a spiced grated cauliflower filling and cooked in ghee.
steps: Knead the atta with about 130 ml of water and half the salt into a soft dough, cover and rest for 15 minutes.
Squeeze the grated cauliflower in a clean cloth to remove as much moisture as possible.
Mix it with the green chilli, ginger, coriander leaves, carom seeds, red chilli powder, garam masala, dry mango powder and the remaining salt.
Divide the dough into 6 balls, roll each into a small round, place a spoon of filling in the centre and seal the edges.
Roll gently into a 6 inch round, dusting with flour as needed.
Cook on a hot tawa, brushing both sides with ghee, until golden spots appear on each side.
Serve hot with curd and pickle.
